status.en: 13 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, 86% more than the week before, most of them in Baghdad, Erbil and Fallujah.
status.nb: 13 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, 86 prosent flere enn uken før, flest i Baghdad, Erbil og Fallujah.

summary.en: Iran-linked drones attacked the Khor Mor gas field in Iraqi Kurdistan, halting production and cutting about 2.8 GW of power. Iraqi forces carried out airstrikes on three suspected militants and a tunnel in Kirkuk’s Zghaitun Valley. Baghdad is negotiating with armed groups and has agreed to reopen the Sheeb border while Turkish forces will withdraw from the Zilkan base by the end of 2026. The UCDP recorded 396 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to its report.
summary.nb: Iran-tilknyttede droner angrep gassfeltet Khor Mor i irakisk Kurdistan, noe som stoppet produksjonen og reduserte kraften med omtrent 2.8 GW. Iraks styrker gjennomførte luftangrep mot tre mistenkte militante og en tunnel i Zghaitun-dalen i Kirkuk. Bagdad forhandler med væpnede grupper og har blitt enige om å gjenåpne Sheeb-grensen, mens tyrkiske styrker vil trekke seg fra Zilkan-basen innen slutten av 2026. UCDP registrerte 396 dødsfall i kamper i 2024, ifølge rapporten.

background.extract: The Iraqi conflict is a series of violent events that began with the 2003 American-led invasion of Iraq and deposition of Iraqi dictator Saddam Hussein, followed by a series of conflicts including the protracted Iraq War (2003–2011), the Iraqi insurgency (2011–2013), the War in Iraq (2013–2017), and most recently, the small-scale Islamic State insurgency in 4 provinces located in Northern Iraq since 2017.
